recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Invasion use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

items.label: Open settings
items.description: On the Automation page, select the settings button on the Auto Invasion card.

items.label: Source castle
items.description: Choose the Great Empire castle that supplies troops and tools for event attacks.
items.recommendation: Use your usual event castle with enough troops and tools.

items.label: Attack preset
items.description: Select a saved Attack Preset with the troops, tools and formation for Foreign Lords or Bloodcrow.
items.recommendation: Create a regular Foreign Lords or Bloodcrow preset first, then select it here.

items.label: Horse travel boost
items.description: Choose the feather, coin or ruby travel option for these attacks.

items.label: Attack capacity
items.description: Preset troop and tool quantities adapt to the selected commander and target capacity.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Invasion source, preset and travel settings
image.caption: Choose a Great Empire source castle and a saved event preset before setting the travel option.

items.label: Foreign Lords difficulty
items.description: Choose an unlocked Foreign Lords difficulty to select when the current event has no difficulty chosen.
items.recommendation: Use the highest unlocked difficulty your usual setup handles reliably.

items.label: Bloodcrow difficulty
items.description: Choose an unlocked Bloodcrow difficulty to select when the current event has no difficulty chosen.
items.recommendation: Use the highest unlocked difficulty your usual setup handles reliably.

items.label: Current difficulty
items.description: Save both event choices; changing either saved value does not replace an active event difficulty.

image.alt: Illustrative Foreign Lords and Bloodcrow difficulty choices
image.caption: Choose a separate unlocked fallback difficulty for each event.

items.label: Stop at event score
items.description: Stop starting new attacks when the reported event score reaches or exceeds this target.
items.recommendation: Use your usual final personal-reward milestone above 0.

items.label: Stop before event ends
items.description: Stop starting new attacks this many minutes before the event ends.

items.label: Daily normal-attack limit
items.description: Stop this automation at the account-wide daily normal-attack count until the game resets it; 0 adds no limit.
items.recommendation: 0 so the event score target controls the run.

items.label: Travelling attacks
items.description: Attacks already travelling may finish after a stop condition and push the final score above the target.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Invasion score and stopping limits
image.caption: The score target stops new launches while already travelling attacks may finish.

items.label: Fortify each target
items.description: If enabled, strengthen each generated enemy castle before attacking it using the selected currency.
items.recommendation: Off unless fortification is part of your regular event strategy.

items.label: Fortification currency
items.description: Choose an option supported by the active event; the game sets each price and selecting rubies explicitly permits ruby spending.
items.recommendation: Event currency when offered and fortification is enabled.

image.caption: Leave fortification off unless you intend to spend an available event currency or explicitly selected rubies.

items.label: Save settings
items.description: Save the source, preset, difficulties, stopping limits and fortification choice before closing this dialog.

items.label: Auto Invasion switch
items.description: Turn on Auto Invasion on the Automation card after saving to run when an event and eligible resources are available.
items.recommendation: On after reviewing and saving your intended settings.

items.label: Attack readiness
items.description: Auto Invasion waits for an active event, eligible commanders and sufficient troops and tools.
